comparison.objective: Couple a scaffold transom to a ledger at a marked position.
comparison.physical_skill: Support and align a long member, close a hinged cap, engage a bolt, and tighten a nut.
comparison.success_condition: Transom square and on-mark, cap shut, bolt slotted, coupler gripping, hands clear for 1 s.
comparison.reason: Structural alignment and fastening are materially different from size-selective sifting.
